Author: Serpens66
Name: Custom Custom Trail
Description: Coordinates Custom Trail sidecars, mission presets and customization, and replaces Coop Trail missions from editable JSON bundles.

Changes: Suppressed transient Custom Trail selection callbacks while opening the Customize lobby so they cannot replace the selected mission preset.
Added sidecar path, existence and enabled-mod diagnostics to Trail load logs.
Captured the currently visible Trail settings synchronously for each individual save instead of carrying an unload snapshot into the next save.
Added an enabled-mod summary to each Trail sidecar capture log entry.
Preserved editable Trail mod settings before the Trail Maker unloads its map during saving.
Prevented capture failures from overwriting sidecars with an all-disabled fallback.
Centralized all Custom Trail sidecar, mission-preset and customization hooks in CustomCustomTrail.
Removed per-settings-mod hook leaders and the Coop reflection bridge.
Added the shared Customize button to all four Coop lobby pages.
Changed missions to schema 2 with canonical seven-mod modSettings and neutral Shared Trail-preset integration.
Removed the top-level startConditions bridge and built-in fallback runtime.
Removed lobby hash verification; missions are mapped only by TrailN/NN.coopmission.json and remain directly editable.
Added slot-based Coop mission replacement with maps, custom lords and ordered AIV lists.
Added SHA-256 lobby verification and shared Start Conditions integration.
